capabilities: Create blank or sample boards stored as .pmboard files
Manage cards with title, owner, stage, priority, due date, and tags
Drag cards between lanes to change status with automatic saving
Edit board-level project metadata such as name, color, and description
extras: README mixes English and Chinese; some commands and UI labels (e.g. 创建 FlowBoard PM 看板, 项目配置) appear in Chinese. The board file format is only shown as a code example without explanation. No screenshots or troubleshooting guidance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in board view for tracking tasks and delivery stages across projects in files within the vault.
summary: Kanban-style project-management board with Linear-like lanes, cards, drag-and-drop status changes, and local .pmboard files.
